quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal 2025 customer concentration: sales to the five largest customers contributed 49.7% of revenue (43.8% in fiscal 2024), and two cloud providers were among the top five customers by revenue. Sales to one cloud provider (not named) were $851.6 million, or 17.9% of total revenue ($532.3 million, or 13.3%, in fiscal 2024; $561.4 million in fiscal 2023), purchasing from the Networking Platforms, Platform Software and Services, and Global Services segments. Sales to AT&T were $500.7 million, or 10.5% of total revenue ($475.3 million, or 11.8%, in fiscal 2024). No other customer reached 10%.
